purpose: Replace further same-history return mining with a prospective minute-factor research track after forty-eight terminal mechanisms produced zero dual-gate factors.

research_goal_adjustment.old_operational_goal: Continue proposing independent factors and reading each factor's 2019-2025 return after no-return gates pass.
research_goal_adjustment.new_operational_goal: Use 2019-2025 minute data only to prove formula integrity, coverage, capacity, and non-duplication; evaluate candidate 49 and later candidates only on observations whose signal session is first seen after this policy.
research_goal_adjustment.reason: After repeated use of the same 2019-2025 outcome history, another historical return diagnostic has increasing selection-bias risk even when the individual formula is preregistered.
research_goal_adjustment.active_goal_remains: Develop a reliable three-local-session A-share stock-selection process, but prioritize out-of-sample validity over the speed or count of historical factor trials.

prospective_boundary.earliest_eligible_signal_session: the first accepted local provider-calendar session on or after 2026-07-27
prospective_boundary.signal_time: after the accepted local session close and after the complete minute snapshot is atomically published
prospective_boundary.exit: third accepted local session close after entry
prospective_boundary.historical_2019_2025_terminal_comparison: only after coverage and capacity pass
prospective_boundary.post_registration_price_or_return_read_a: only after the corresponding source session is atomically accepted and was not available to the research process before registration

candidate_admission_order: formula and field-whitelist preregistration before candidate values
immutable 2019-2025 candidate snapshot without daily prices or forward returns
coverage and CNY 200000 board-lot capacity eligibility before comparison values
one immutable prospective registration before the first eligible future signal
early rejection or full promotion gate without changing the registered formula

future_observation_protocol.signal_frequency: every accepted local session once the factor and eligibility set are complete
future_observation_protocol.unfilled_entry_policy: keep the slot in cash without replacement
future_observation_protocol.blocked_exit_policy: retain the position and retry on later accepted closes for at most twenty local sessions
future_observation_protocol.overlapping_positions: allowed only in one shared cash-constrained portfolio; no cohort may spend cash not available before its entry
future_observation_protocol.same_session_amount_use: after-outcome capacity audit only and never a fill claim or ranking input

early_rejection.rule: Retire without inversion or replacement when mean future Rank IC is nonpositive and the shared CNY 200000 portfolio net return at the primary cost is nonpositive.

full_evaluation.promotion_result: Passing one factor permits continued paper observation only; historical aggregation still requires at least two economically independent prospectively passing factors.

multiplicity_control.candidate_50_activation_allowed: only after candidate 49 is terminally rejected or has completed the full 200-signal evaluation

forbidden_actions: read candidate 49 historical daily prices or forward returns
use 2026-07-14 through registration-time observations as a hidden holdout
backfill a future ledger with sessions already available before registration
activate multiple new mechanisms in parallel
combine, score, select, size, or order from the forty-eight terminal mechanisms
change gates after observing a future result
purchase or scrape Level-2 solely to rescue a failed Level-1 mechanism
